title: Reports emerge of screen issues on the new iPhone Duo
excerpt: Users report screen damage and cracks appearing above the hinge shortly after the launch of the iPhone Duo foldable phone.
body_html:
Shortly after the release of the new foldable iPhone Duo, users began reporting issues with the device's inner display. Within hours of the launch on Friday, buyers shared photos on social media showing damage located in the middle of the screen directly above the hinge.

The reported problems consistently featured lines and cracks appearing across the folding area on brand-new devices. While the exact cause remains under observation, the shared images demonstrate a recurring pattern of screen failure in the middle section corresponding to the placement of the hinge.
